events.title: Mary Mack Stand Up Comedy in Superior, WI - October 30
events.description: Cheesehead, clean comedians Mack & Harmston's duet stand up show in support of a pro-union election. General public welcome & encouraged! A union member herself, Mack has been seen on The Tonight Show, Dry Bar Comedy, Last Comic Standing, Grand Ole Opry and more. She is one of the most played comics on SiriusXM and currently voices Jesse in the Hulu and Netflix cartoon Solar Opposites. The night features a full show by Mary & Tim and quick word or two from (and maybe some roasting of) the district's political candidates. Much needed levity before the midterms.

events.description: Teague Alexy performs a special Pizza Luce brunch set as part of Pizza Luce's 25th anniversary weekend. Teague's storytelling has deeper roots to his Irish ancestry.

events.description: One show in Duluth. Please come. Geoffrey Asmus began performing stand-up in 2013 immediately after wasting $143,548 on seven college degrees. Martin Sexton
events.description: America comes together in the music of Martin Sexton. Our hearts mend, our political and philosophical differences melt away, and the various strains of our roots music entangle. Of Sexton, The New York Times says: “His unpretentious heartiness helps him focus on every soul singer’s goal: to amplify the sound of the ordinary heart." Sexton has remained true to his mission of sharing peace and harmony throughout his 10 albums, and in countless incendiary live performances. He has thus built a loyal following of fans, including critics and superstar artists.
